subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the Google thinking-payload sanitizer slice and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios auth-stack slice are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack slice be split now?
rationale: The open sanitizer PR covers only one slice, while the remaining ADC/dependency path touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term ownership boundary alone.

options.title: Keep This Issue Canonical
options.body: Review and land or supersede the sanitizer PR, then keep this issue open until the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path has live proof or a dedicated follow-up exists.

options.title: Split ADC/Gaxios Follow-Up
options.body: Move the service-account ADC and gaxios/node-fetch/domexception path into a new canonical issue, then let this issue close only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Accept Sanitizer-Only Scope
options.body: A provider owner can explicitly scope this issue to the sanitizer bug only, but should preserve the ADC reproduction in a linked issue before closing.

recommendation.title: Keep This Issue Canonical
recommendation.body: Review and land or supersede the sanitizer PR, then keep this issue open until the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path has live proof or a dedicated follow-up exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider architecture, Plugin SDK helper ownership, dependency policy, and issue-cluster triage.
